stick.gimbal.name: Stick (roll / pitch)
stick.gimbal.note: grip connector / shaft exit on top of the leather boot

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the CLS-E MK II joystick base alone (no grip) seen from the front left, slightly from above; leather boot with the threaded grip connector on top
mappingSource: catalog brunner.json (fact sheet https://shop.brunner-simulation.ch/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/20180903_Brunner_FactSheet_CLS-E-MKII-Joystick.pdf): JOY_X roll, JOY_Y pitch; the catalog note says the base is not a DirectInput joystick by itself (the grip's own USB device carries the buttons, FFB via CLS2Sim)
note: The photo shows the base without a grip; the gimbal is marked at the shaft exit on top of the boot (grip connector).
